reason: U2 defines the backend browse/search/cache contract hardening scope for self-hosted maturity.
Public Library and Public Catalog HTTP handlers must parse query strings at the HTTP boundary and delegate access-aware work to app services.
Server route tests and focused nextest gates must follow the established Nako server quality pattern.
Repository-backed browse/search filters must apply access, ordering, deduplication, and pagination in the storage query contract.
Public Client browse/search DTO and route behavior must remain additive and redaction-safe.
This slice crosses frontend query state, generated SDK serialization, HTTP parsing, service delegation, and repository filtering.
